jobs.employer_name: Boehringer Ingelheim Pharma GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description: Boehringer Ingelheim is a biopharmaceutical company active in both human and animal health. As one of the industry's top investors in research and development, the company focuses on developing innovative therapies that can improve and extend lives in areas of high unmet medical need. Independent since its foundation in 1885, Boehringer takes a long-term perspective, embedding sustainability along the entire value chain. Our approximately 54,500 employees serve over 130 markets to build a healthier and more sustainable tomorrow. Learn more at www.boehringer-ingelheim.comThe PositionAre you an accomplished medicinal chemist who wants to help address one of the most urgent challenges in global health? Join our new AMR (Antimicrobial Resistance) Innovation Hub at our research site in Biberach an der Riß, Germany.The AMR Innovation Hub will focus on the discovery and development of next-generation antibiotics and vaccines against high-priority pathogens. Combining internal capabilities with external scientific expertise, the Hub aims to accelerate the discovery of differentiated new therapeutic concepts.As a Principal Scientist in Medicinal Chemistry, you will provide scientific leadership for innovative antibacterial drug discovery projects. You will define medicinal chemistry and compound progression strategies, lead multidisciplinary teams and translate biological insights into high-quality development candidates. You will also foster collaborations with academic institutions, biotechnology companies and other external partners, helping establish the AMR Innovation Hub as a leading environment for anti-infective research.Ready to make an impact against antimicrobial resistance? Apply now and help create the next generation of anti-infective medicines.Discover our Biberach site: xplorebiberach.comThis position can be filled either as Senior Principal Scientist or Principal Scientist.This position is part time eligible with 80 %.Tasks & responsibilities- You will work in/lead antibacterial drug discovery projects, contributing to new target ideas and modalities and work in interdisciplinary teams from early hit assessment through lead optimization and development candidate selection.- You will establish medicinal chemistry and compound progression strategies by integrating structure-activity relationships, antibacterial activity, resistance data, structural information, pharmacokinetics and safety parameters.- You will lead molecular design and compound prioritization, applying state-of-the-art synthetic chemistry as well as computational, structural and data-driven approaches.- You will build productive collaborations across internal functions and with academic groups, biotechnology companies and contract research organizations.- You will shape intellectual property strategies and communicate project opportunities, progress and risks to internal governance bodies and external partners.Additional tasks for the Senior Principal Scientist role:- You will provide scientific leadership to interdisciplinary discovery teams in AMR in the discovery phase and clinical development.- You will actively contribute to strategy and direction of the AMR hub beyond the scope of medicinal chemistry.Requirements- PhD in medicinal chemistry, synthetic organic chemistry or a related discipline.- > 5 years of relevant industry experience in antibacterial discovery; expertise in bacterial selective compound design and profiling is particularly valuable. Comprehensive knowledge of modern medicinal chemistry and synthetic methodologies, with a strong track record of advancing projects from hit identification through lead optimization to candidate selection.- Demonstrated scientific and project leadership in multidisciplinary teams, including the ability to define strategy, make evidence-based decisions and deliver results in complex research environments.- Strong communication and collaboration skills, including experience with external partnerships; fluent written and spoken English is required.Additional requirements for the Senior Principal Scientist role:- > 10 years of relevant industry experience in antibacterial discovery.- Extensive experience in leading multidisciplinary projects in AMR.As part of our commitment to transparency and fairness, salary information will be shared during the recruitment process. We also offer a comprehensive benefits and wellbeing package.Applications from people with severe disabilities are warmly welcomed. In cases of equal qualifications, such applicants will be given preferential consideration in the selection process.What We OfferWith us, you can develop your own path in a company with a culture that knows our differences are our strengths - and break new ground in the drive to make millions of lives better.Here, your development is our priority. Supporting you to build a career as part of a workplace that is independent, authentic and bold, while tackling challenging work in a respectful and friendly environment where everyone is valued and welcomed.Alongside, you have access to programs and groups that ensure your health and wellbeing are looked after - as we make major investments to drive global accessibility to healthcare. By being part of a team that is constantly innovating, you'll be helping to transform lives for generations.Want to learn more? Visit https://www.boehringer-ingelheim.comReady to contact us?If you have any questions about the job posting or process - please contact our HR Direct Team, Tel: +49 (0) 6132 77-3330 or via mail: hr.de@boehringer-ingelheim.comRecruitment process:Step 1: Online application - The job posting is presumably online until December 9th, 2026. We reserve the right to take the posting offline beforehand. Applications up to December 2nd, 2026 are guaranteed to be considered.Step 2: Virtual meeting in the period from beginning to mid-December.Step 3: On-site interviews mid-January 2027Please submit your application documents in English.
